guard: connector diagnostics preserve whether core observed broker-confirmed zero subscribers or only an elapsed reply deadline
command: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && corepack pnpm smoke:manager-invoke-verdict
completionMarker: ...and reports an attributed successful status as READY
why: The two observations authorize opposite conclusions. A broker no-responders sentinel proves
the request reached zero subscribers and was not executed. A reply deadline proves only that
nothing attributable came back; the handler may be slow or stalled and an effect may exist.
Collapsing them invites an unsafe spawn retry, which is the live incident's product boundary.
The smoke imports core through dist, so every mutation command builds core first and the
restore hook rebuilds it after mutation-proof restores the source. Connector source is loaded
directly by tsx. Both mutations kill the same user-visible assertions on purpose: one drops
the typed observation in core, the other ignores it at the connector rendering boundary.
